title: interview.session_completed.v1
description: The session ended and will not resume. Evaluation begins from this. It carries how it ended, because an abandoned session and a finished one produce different evaluations and conflating them would attribute silence to the candidate.

turn_count.description: How many turns were taken, so a consumer can tell a session with nothing in it from a full one without fetching the transcript.

duration_seconds.description: Wall-clock length, excluding time the session was interrupted.
